title: Global crash recovery and reverse engineering programs outside the US

tellings.quote: And there are there are global crash recovery and reverse engineering programs um outside the US.

plain: Other countries besides the United States run their own programmes to recover crashed non-human craft and reverse engineer them, meaning take them apart to learn how they work. Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he once helped carry a recovered UFO, tells Michels this as something he was told, and gives no names or countries.
